mentions.name: Tech Talks Weekly
mentions.description: A free weekly email newsletter curating recently published software engineering conference talks from hundreds of conferences (Devoxx, KubeCon, PyCon, QCon, LeadDev, JSNation, and more). Each edition features must-watch talks with hand-written summaries plus a list of everything else uploaded that week, and occasional special editions such as "The Most Watched Talks of 2024" (a 2025 edition is in progress). It has grown to 8,700+ readers.
mentions.problem: Started as a personal project to fix messy YouTube subscriptions and RSS feeds that made it hard to track newly published conference talks.
mentions.audience: Software engineers who watch software engineering conference talks.

mentions.name: Tech Talks Weekly
mentions.description: A weekly newsletter that emails subscribers every new software engineering conference talk and podcast published that week. A paid tier adds access to a searchable, filterable database of 48,000+ talks and podcasts since 2020 (searchable by title, conference/podcast, view count, date, and duration), rankings of the most-watched talks over 7/30/90-day and 6/12-month windows, and category-based browsing of new talks and podcasts by tech stack, language, and domain (Software Architecture, Backend, Frontend, Full Stack, Data, ML, DevOps, Security, Leadership, and major languages and ecosystems).
mentions.audience: Software engineers who want a weekly digest of the latest software engineering conference talks and podcasts
